retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast monochrome portrait of a man in a tuxedo wearing a metallic gold phoropter as a mask, featuring wide-tracked gold sans-serif typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, close-up portrait of a man in formal attire where the upper half of his face is obscured by a complex, mechanical phoropter rendered in polished gold. The skin and clothing are desaturated to near-monochrome, set against a solid black background, creating a stark contrast with the reflective gold elements and typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Gold mechanical mask vs. desaturated human skin
Symmetrical phoropter vs. centered facial features
Wide-tracked gold text vs. solid black negative space
Formal tuxedo vs. surreal medical equipment
coreInvariants: The phoropter must be rendered in a reflective gold metallic finish.
The background must be absolute black.
The subject's face and clothing must be desaturated/monochrome.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centrally aligned, filling the frame from the chest up, with the phoropter acting as the primary focal point at the top-center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The gold phoropter serves as the heavy visual anchor, drawing the eye immediately to the top half of the image.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the gold mask down to the bow tie, then outward to the wide-tracked typography at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space surrounds the subject and provides a canvas for the floating gold text.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between the zero-saturation background and the high-value, metallic gold accents.
paletteRestrictions: No vibrant colors other than gold
Strict monochrome for the human subject

characterSpecificRedesigns: The forward slash is used as a central divider in the numeric sequence.

composition.relationshipToImage: Floating over the subject's chest and background

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used with varying scales and extreme tracking.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric structure and modern authority.
Provides the necessary geometric 'O' and sharp terminals.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast monochrome portrait of a man in a black tuxedo and white shirt against a black background. Overlay a highly detailed, mechanical phoropter (eye exam machine) over his eyes, rendered in polished, reflective gold.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three lines of centered, uppercase geometric sans-serif text in a metallic gold finish. Use extreme tracking so the letters span the width of the torso. The middle line should include numbers separated by a gold forward slash.

verificationChecks: Is the text tracking extremely wide?

postGenerationChecks: Check for metallic gold consistency between mask and text
Verify the phoropter is centered on the face
Ensure the background is pure black without noise
Confirm the typography is perfectly horizontal and centered
